description: This file contains React components and hooks for accessibility enhancements, including screen reader-only text, skip links, live regions, focus traps, keyboard navigation, status and progress announcers, error announcers, MCP-specific accessibility features, and utility hooks for managing focus and announcements.

classes.name: ScreenReaderOnly
classes.description: Component for rendering text only visible to screen readers.

classes.name: SkipLink
classes.description: Component for providing skip links for keyboard navigation.

classes.name: LiveRegion
classes.description: Component for creating ARIA live regions for dynamic content updates.

classes.name: FocusTrap
classes.description: Component that traps focus within its children, useful for modal dialogs.

classes.name: KeyboardNavigable
classes.description: Component that handles keyboard navigation and key events.

classes.name: StatusAnnouncer
classes.description: Component for announcing status updates to screen readers.

classes.name: ProgressAnnouncer
classes.description: Component for announcing progress of long-running operations.

classes.name: ErrorAnnouncer
classes.description: Component for announcing form errors and validation messages.

classes.name: MCPAccessibilityProvider
classes.description: Component providing MCP-specific accessibility skip links.

classes.name: useAccessibility
classes.description: Hook providing functions to announce status, errors, and focus elements.

methods.name: announceStatus
methods.description: Function to announce a status message via ARIA live region.

methods.name: announceError
methods.description: Function to announce an error message via ARIA live region.

methods.name: focusElement
methods.description: Function to focus and scroll to a specific element by selector.
